query_level_trigger.name: An indexer node disk is above 75%

script.source: for (def n : ctx.results[0].nodes.values()) { if (n.fs != null && n.fs.total.total_in_bytes > 0) { double used = 1.0 - ((double) n.fs.total.available_in_bytes / n.fs.total.total_in_bytes); if (used > 0.75) { return true; } } } return false;
